text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Our goal isn't just to make the board.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Take first place. Show Funabashi's strength to the JRA.
That is our objective.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Which is why... I cannot be satisfied yet.
I must work harder and harder, over and over!

Now then, if it's alright with you...
would you like to watch the race footage when we get back?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I wish to make it clear what you did well as a Trainer, and what actually went poorly.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: In order to win our next race.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: "I was just thinking how neither of us has changed. Past or present, Funabashi or the JRA."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"That makes me so very happy,
Trainer."
